name: Jellyfish-Neural/01
title: The model's marks
marks_label: marks; 580 of them, on 28 cells, are training labels
about: The jellyfish video. The model marked 171 neurons in the first frame and followed 38 of them, one mark every 10 frames (rings). The 28 that nobody annotated train the tracker; the 10 that have a white reference track were followed only to check the marks against the hand annotation.

names.agent: The model's marks, joined by straight lines (only the marks are training labels)
names.ref: Reference track of the same cell (not used for training)
